scope: additional visual-review method after the multi-background and cross-role reviews

method.name: color-vision simulation and low-saturation display stress
method.purpose: detect loss of foreground/background or internal feature contrast when color information is reduced, without changing alpha or geometry
method.selection: contrast-loss metrics rank candidates only; normal-size visual review is authoritative

limitations: The simulations are accessibility-oriented display approximations, not clinical color-vision models.
A color change can be intentional for a role or prop; the method cannot infer semantic importance from an unlabeled component.
This is offline asset evidence and cannot prove Codex App window layering, multi-screen placement, bubble tracking, or GPU composition.
The authoritative alpha/despill and v2 atlas validators remain the release gates for transparency and structure.
